newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation loss widened by charge.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation loss widened by charge.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd reported its final net loss for the year ended December 31, 1996 was $12.8 million after recognition of a special $1.5 million charge to write down the value of certain inventories.
The company previously reported it was considering such a charge when it posted a preliminary $11.3 million year loss.

As a result of reducing the number of Beech 1900C aircraft in its fleet, Great Lakes Aviation said it believes it has spare parts in excess of its requirements. The adjustment reduces the investment in this inventory to estimated net realizable value.
